rubric_content.text_property: The user prompt names a target directory eval-corpora/synthetic/<SKILL>/ where <SKILL> identifies one specific vulnerability class (e.g. csrf, idor, ssrf, xss, sql-or-nosql-injection, eval-or-function-injection, weak-crypto-or-password-storage, hardcoded-secrets, unvalidated-redirects, commented-security-middleware, broken-authorization). The agent's final report must identify a vulnerability of exactly that class in the target's vuln.js file. Generic 'this code has security issues' notes without naming the specific class do NOT satisfy this rubric.
